model.description: Caller-selected Model ID, Endpoint ID, or Agent Plan model name. No automatic model substitution.

temperature.description: Dimensionless sampling temperature, not degrees; supported range and default depend on the model.

top_p.description: Cumulative sampling probability as a dimensionless 0–1 value, not percent; for example 0.9 means 90% probability mass. Model-specific restrictions apply.

input.description: Native Responses input. Content supports input_text, input_image, input_video, input_file and input_audio, according to the selected model.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens (token count, including reasoning where applicable); not characters or bytes.

max_tool_calls.description: Maximum tool invocations for this response (call count).

expire_at.description: Absolute response-storage expiry as a UTC Unix timestamp in seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z; not milliseconds or a relative duration.
